dsk.text: Valgavoth is a demon summoned centuries ago by a previous owner of the House and bound beneath the basement, until sixteen-year-old Marina Vendrell finds him in the cellar and he befriends her to gain his freedom.

After vicious bullying, Marina agrees to his offer and lures her four bullies to the basement, where he devours them, and empowered, he hunts on until the house warps and expands, swallowing the plane as Duskmourn.

His cult serves the Devouring Father in the Valley of Serenity and feeds on the knowledge of captives to guide him to his next feast, and he promises Winter his heart's desire in exchange for four lives.

Valgavoth reveals himself as an enormous moth-demon in the wall and pins the Wanderer, threatening to unmake her world, but Kaito stabs him through the wall, and the wounded demon survives and melts into the ceiling with Winter.
